summary: One week to Expo; booth ships tomorrow. Print files sent, script final, scoring API and Coastal ranking done. Harbor's legal wants an uptime clause before signing, and the renewal is due Oct 30. Nina's 10x load test runs at 2pm. Pinecrest kickoff is Thursday.
